question: Which Indian Army unit represented India in VINBAX, conducted in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Corps of Engineers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Corps of Engineers** of the Indian Army represented India in the **VINBAX** exercise held in **November 2024**. This unit specializes in engineering and infrastructure-related operations in the Army.
 
• **VINBAX** is a bilateral military exercise conducted between **India** and **Vietnam**, focusing on enhancing military cooperation and interoperability between the two nations.
 
• The participation of the **Corps of Engineers** in VINBAX highlights India’s focus on infrastructure development and disaster relief capabilities as part of military collaboration.
 
• The exercise enables the two countries to share expertise in **engineering support, disaster management, and counter-insurgency operations**.
 
• This unit’s involvement reflects the Indian Army’s commitment to strengthening ties with Vietnam and contributing to regional peace and security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Corps of Engineers:**

 
 
• Established in **1780**, the Corps of Engineers is one of the oldest arms of the Indian Army.
 
• It is responsible for **construction, combat engineering, and providing infrastructure support** during both peace and war times.
 
• The Corps also plays a key role in **disaster relief operations**, contributing to civilian infrastructure development in emergencies.
 
• Its personnel are highly skilled in **bridge construction, minefield clearing, and water supply management**.
 
 
 
• **VINBAX:**
 
 
• VINBAX (Vietnam-India Bilateral Army Exercise) is a joint military exercise aimed at boosting **defense cooperation** between India and Vietnam.
 
• The exercise focuses on areas such as **peacekeeping operations, training, and capacity building**.
 
• It highlights the strategic partnership between the two countries, especially in the context of the **Indo-Pacific region**.
 
• VINBAX is part of the broader **Act East Policy** of India, emphasizing deeper engagements with Southeast Asian nations.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Indian Army in Bilateral Exercises:**
 
 
• The Indian Army participates in several bilateral and multilateral military exercises to enhance **interoperability** and share expertise with other nations.
 
• These exercises contribute to **confidence-building measures** and strengthen diplomatic relations.
 
• Examples include **Yudh Abhyas** with the US, **Indra** with Russia, and **Shakti** with France.
 
 
 
• **Other Units of the Indian Army:**
 
 
• **Gorkha Rifles:** Known for their valor and discipline, they specialize in **mountain warfare**.
 
• **Mechanised Infantry Regiment:** Focuses on **armored operations**, using infantry fighting vehicles for mobility.
 
• **Parachute Regiment:** Specializes in **airborne operations**, including rapid deployment and counter-terrorism roles.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India-Vietnam Relations:**

 
 
• India and Vietnam share **strong bilateral ties** based on mutual trust, cultural connections, and strategic interests.
 
• The defense relationship has strengthened significantly, with joint exercises like VINBAX and **cooperation in maritime security**.
 
• Both countries emphasize the importance of a **free, open, and inclusive Indo-Pacific**.
 
 
 
• **Act East Policy:**
 
 
• Launched in **1991**, this policy aims to strengthen India’s ties with Southeast and East Asian nations.
 
• It focuses on **economic integration, cultural ties, and strategic collaboration**.
 
• Defense cooperation forms a key pillar of this policy, including initiatives like military exercises and defense agreements.
